unknownFields: Preserved unsupported pending complete governing classification
association: One original pg_range adjunct keyed by original rngtypid, no invented object OID. Both independently admitted range and multirange requests may cover the same row; preserve both coverage edges without duplicating definition.
parentAdmission: Resolve actual pg_type kinds and complete definitions under one cut; range and multirange endpoints must match the original unique adjunct. Missing or conflicting adjunct never means supported empty type.
operatorAdmission: Resolve actual btree access method and full selected opclass/family/input/member meaning. A name match or default-opclass flag cannot substitute for original subtype compatibility and comparator qualification.
routineAdmission: Nonzero canonical routine requires original one-range-argument/same-range-result signature; nonzero difference routine requires original two-subtype-argument/double-precision-result signature, including full argument modes/kind and executable provenance. Resolve return types as original native identities, not spelling or hardcoded OIDs. Zero remains absence. Complete signatures are required but do not qualify mathematical behavior.
canonicalProducer: Resolved range/multirange/subtype definitions, optional collation and routines, opclass/family/comparator plus required policy/dependency associations. Preserve finite complete cyclic closure through definition identities; no recursive hashing or name-derived endpoint pairing.
additionalRequiredDefinitions: collation declared facts and separately qualified environment when applicable
full operator-family/member/comparator and routine implementation/authority closure
original comments/extensions/dependencies and containing type policy
observationPolicy: Do not invoke canonical, difference, comparator, casts or value I/O as a discovery shortcut; independently qualify executable semantics in selected conformance tests.
